buildTarget.description: The target to run to build you the app.

buildTargetOptions.description: Additional options to pass into the build target.

watch.description: To run a file in watch mode

hot.description: Enable auto reload in bun's JavaScript runtime

config.description: Config file to load bun from (e.g. -c bunfig.toml

tsConfig.description: Load tsconfig from path instead of cwd/tsconfig.json

smol.description: In memory-constrained environments, use the smol flag to reduce memory usage at a cost to performance.

bun.description: Force a script or package to use Bun.js instead of Node.js (via symlinking node)

runBuildTargetDependencies.description: Whether to run dependencies before running the build. Set this to true if the project does not build libraries from source (e.g. 'buildLibsFromSource: false').

waitUntilTargets.description: The targets to run before starting the node app. Listed in the form <project>:<target>. The main target will run once all listed targets have output something to the console.
